1. GP FOR HOME 2.
MADHAVA RAO NALLURI THE HONOURABLE DR.JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA WRIT PETITION NO: 13543 of 2021

The Court made the following Order:
This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer for:
".... to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of respondents, particularly the 4th respondent at the instance of respondents 5 and 6 in repeatedly insisting petitioner to appear before the 4th respondent police station and insisting him to vacate and deliver the agricultural Land of Ac 4.58 Cents comprising Ac 1.56 Cents, Ac 2.20 Cents, and Ac 0.82 Cents respectively covered by Sy. No.249/1C, 250, 249/1 of Raghavapuram Revenue Village and house site of Ac.0.25 Cents covered by Sy. No- 254/1 of Raghavapuram Revenue Village in Chintalapudi Mandal of West Godavari District to 5th respondent, as illegal, irregular, irrational, arbitrary, without any authority or sanction of law and violative of Articles 14 and 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the 4th respondent not to interfere in any manner with petitioner's possession over the said lands and his personal liberty"
2.

Sri Md.Farooq, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on written instructions, would submit that basing on the representation of the unofficial respondent, crime has been registered Kanchi Rambabu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91495046/
2 against the petitioner herein vide Crime No.467 of 2021 on the file of the Chintalapudi Police Station, West Godavari District, for the offences punishable under Sections 448, 307 and 420 IPC.

sentences.text: He would further submit that four (04) other crimes were also registered against the petitioner herein and the Police are not interfering with the civil disputes between the parties.
3. Recording the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, the Writ Petition is disposed of, at the stage of admission itself.
However, the Police are directed to follow due process of law, regarding the crimes registered against the petitioner herein.
No order as to costs.
Interlocutory applications, if any, pending shall stand closed.
